notes: IMPORTANT FIX TO THE TRAINING COPY: if you opened the training copy and then used Switch company (or Different company) and chose the same company again, the orange TRAINING bar stayed on screen although the REAL books were open, so practice entries went into the real books. Fixed: the bar now shows only while the training copy is really open. If you used the training copy since 0.6.131, check your real books for practice vouchers on the days you practised and reverse any that are not real. ALSO: sub-accounts in the chart of accounts (Chart of Accounts, + Sub-account), with headings and their parts in the Trial Balance, Income & Expenditure, Financial Position, Notes and Budget Control; and a User Guide and window that suit a bigger monitor. Installing: one new migration adds the sub-account column; no figure changes. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
